name: S. Anna di Isola Capo Rizzuto
terms: Denominazione di Origine Controllata. The label names a precise area, and the wine is tested during production.

blurb.text: A Calabrian appellation in the province of Crotone, covering Crotone, Cutro and Isola di Capo Rizzuto. Its rules allow seven main grapes, including Gaglioppo, Greco Bianco and Nerello Mascalese.
